input: Select an interface and generation for live operations. Record within explicit byte and entry limits. Export sealed files by byte offset. Upload archives in bounded base64 chunks under the initiating credential. Replay with an entry cursor and optional elapsed microseconds.
output: Returns native descriptor provenance, exact raw and decoded observations, ordered loss and terminal markers, recording limits and archived source generation. Deterministic replay returns observations at the selected clock.
effect: An explicit recording retains subsequent deliveries independently of display refresh. Stop seals the retained prefix. Discard releases it. Imported replays are isolated from live acquisition and routing.
guard: Authenticated reads inspect metadata, status, bounded archive slices and replay pages. Recording and upload lifecycle changes require write scope. Native device access policy remains authoritative. A chunk retry must match the original bytes at its offset.
lifecycle: Replay handles and uploads belong to the initiating client. Closing a live capture seals its recording. A sealed recording remains exportable by its original generation until discarded. Close a replay or cancel an upload to release its storage.
scenario: The running Debug cockpit and authenticated MCP compare recorded hardware reports and replay them. File import exercises authored portable descriptors for additional value domains. Native tests cover capacity, disconnects and invalid uploads.
